VERDICT: The implementation correctly isolates static top-level named arguments, handles redundant parentheses, and rejects dynamic GString keys as proven by the Groovy 2.4.21 probe and passing test suite.
ACTION ITEMS: No code changes are required; the staged repair is complete and the focused test suite passes under both standard and optimized Python execution.
STATIC-KEY CONSEQUENCE: Statically known single/double-quoted keys are accurately extracted at top argument depth, including duplicates and escaped characters, while dynamic and nested keys are correctly excluded.
CORPUS CONSEQUENCE: The pinned 228-line TSV output remains byte-identical, confirming that the repair introduces no regressions to existing corpus analysis results.
